question: Who conveyed the teaching to the auspicious earth-moving yoginīs?
premises: They are described as good eaters
inference: An earth-mover conveyed the teaching to the auspicious earth-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The epithet subhakṣāṇāṃ may have a technical sense.
plain_english: O beloved, it was told to the auspicious earth-moving yoginīs by an earth-mover.
